answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The defense holds because trust accrues slowly and is lost fast, so a farm that ever submits a copied answer destroys the value of that identity. Consider a basalt as the anchor of the cost. A willow stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a jetty...
